end.summary:
• Practised neutralisation in daily life: ant bites, antacids, soil, toothpaste and factory waste.
• Explained that an acid and base react to form salt and water, releasing heat.
• Correctly distinguished neutralisation from dilution in most examples.
• Indicator colour changes and the exact neutral point remained uncertain; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Khushi practised applying neutralisation to everyday examples and explained the acid–base reaction using salt, water and heat. They used the correct method for ant bites, soil treatment, toothpaste and distinguishing water dilution from neutralisation. They mixed up the exact indicator colour at the neutral point and did not fully correct this by the end. At home, practise with a simple three-step example: acid colour, just enough base at neutral, and extra base colour.
